Which FCC licence files hold the most active licences?

Which states have the largest households on average?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS avg_household_size FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25010' AND a.variable = 'B25010_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. patents are design patents rather than utility patents?
SELECT patent_type, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which New York counties had the highest average unemployment rate in 2024?

Which cities are served by the most separate water systems?

SELECT concat(city_served, ', ', state_served), count(DISTINCT pwsid) AS systems FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_geographic_areas WHERE city_served IS NOT NULL AND concat(city_served, ', ', state_served) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people in the Bronx live below the poverty line?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36005' AND variable = 'B17001_E002'

How many pages does a government form run on average?
SELECT avg(pages) AS average FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE pages > 0

SELECT state, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was ERCOT's peak hourly electricity demand in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.ERCO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '2023%'

SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_metal AS varchar) = 'true'

How many published applications came through the international PCT route?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_committee_linkages

SELECT CASE direct_indirect_ownership WHEN 'D' THEN 'direct' WHEN 'I' THEN 'indirect' ELSE 'not stated' END AS ownership, count(*) AS transactions, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT parent_company_utility_name AS company, count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT point_of_delivery_balancing_authority AS grid_area, round(sum(try_cast(standardized_quantity AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_transactions WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2023%' AND product_name = 'ENERGY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average net price for in-state students at the University of Michigan-Ann Arbor?
SELECT try_cast(npt4_pub AS double) AS net_price FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE instnm = 'University of Michigan-Ann Arbor'
Which counties' hospitals handled the most discharges in 2016?
SELECT hospital_county, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND hospital_county IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many dockets concern civil rights claims about employment?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE nature_of_suit LIKE '442%'
Which section 527 political organisations reported spending the most?
SELECT column03 AS organisation, round(sum(try_cast(column13 AS double))) AS spent FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of reactions found in granted patents change from 1980 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('1980', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which power plants have the biggest single generating units?

SELECT plant_name, state, technology, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS largest_unit_mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the Henry Hub natural gas spot price on February 17, 2021?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_mmbtu FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.RNGWHHD.D' AND period = '20210217'
Which kinds of air permits are most common among EPA-tracked facilities?
SELECT caa_permit_types, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL AND caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many brand-new public schools opened for the 2023-24 school year?
SELECT count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE sy_status_text = 'New' AND school_year = '2023-2024'
Which electric utilities had the most residential customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(customers AS double) AS residential_customers FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What exchange rate did the Treasury set for the euro at the end of 2024?
SELECT try_cast(exchange_rate AS double) AS euros_per_dollar FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange WHERE country_currency_desc = 'Euro Zone-Euro' AND record_date = '2024-12-31'
Among districts with at least 10,000 students, which spent the most per pupil in fiscal 2017?

SELECT name, stabbr, round(try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) / try_cast(v33 AS double)) AS per_pupil FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' AND try_cast(v33 AS double) >= 10000 AND try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many security interests in patents were recorded in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS security_interests FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignment WHERE convey_text LIKE 'SECURITY%' AND substr(record_dt, 6, 4) = '2023'
Which states have had the most water discharge permit inspections?
SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which patents granted in 2022 had the most claims?
SELECT patent_id, patent_title, num_claims FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE patent_date LIKE '2022%' ORDER BY try_cast(num_claims AS integer) DESC LIMIT 10
Which states generated the most nuclear power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.NUC-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much debt had the Black Lung Disability Trust Fund built up by the end of fiscal 2024?
Black Lung Disability Trust Fund Results

SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS cumulative_debt FROM govblock_treasury.black_lung_disability_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc = 'Cumulative debt, end of year'
Which U.S. cities had the most residents in 2025?
SELECT name, stname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How did Defense Department contract obligations change from fiscal 2015 to fiscal 2024?

SELECT cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) AS year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(awarding_agency_name) = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which contaminants are behind the most drinking water violations?

SELECT r.value_description, count(DISTINCT v.violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement AS v JOIN govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_ref_code_values AS r ON r.value_code = v.contaminant_code AND r.value_type LIKE 'CONTAMINANT%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemical entities take part in Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_chebiid_name
Which industry sectors paid the highest average wages nationwide in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.industry_title, try_cast(q.avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_industry_titles AS t ON t.industry_code = q.industry_code WHERE q.area_fips = 'US000' AND q.agglvl_code = '14' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What share of the water sources used by public systems are surface water?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN water_type_code = 'SW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_facilities WHERE is_source_ind = 'Y'
Which insurers file the most property and casualty rate changes in Texas?
SELECT company_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_property_casualty_rate_filings WHERE company_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many write-in votes were counted for president in California in 2024?

SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'CALIFORNIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND writein = 'TRUE' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024'
Which states have the highest income per person?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b19301' AND a.variable = 'B19301_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do public housing tenants pay in rent each month on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rent_per_month AS double))) AS avg_rent FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE program_label = 'Public Housing' AND try_cast(rent_per_month AS double) > 0
Which states have the most clinicians profiled in Open Payments?
SELECT covered_recipient_profile_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.op_covered_recipient_profile WHERE covered_recipient_profile_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What net patient revenue did hospitals report in total for fiscal 2023?

SELECT sum(try_cast(itm_val_num AS double)) AS net_patient_revenue FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE wksht_cd = 'G300000' AND line_num = '00300' AND clmn_num = '00100' AND cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which research institutions have published the most works, according to OpenAlex?
SELECT display_name, country_code, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Rhea reactions have been retired as obsolete?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_obsoletes
Which companies are named as owner on the most trademark filings?
SELECT own_name, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federally qualified health centers filed cost reports for fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_fqhc14_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which journals charge authors the highest publication fees?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(apc_usd AS double) AS fee_usd FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What did residential customers pay for natural gas per thousand cubic feet in January 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_mcf FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.N3010US3.M' AND period = '202301'
Which kinds of cross-reference does ChEBI record most often?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_database_accession WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 13F holdings reports were filed for the quarter ending December 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_submission WHERE submissiontype = '13F-HR' AND periodofreport = '31-DEC-2024'
Which federal district courts receive the most patent lawsuits?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS dockets FROM govblock_courts.dockets AS d JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = d.court_id WHERE d.nature_of_suit LIKE '830%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many put options on the iShares 20+ Year Treasury fund appear in 13F filings?
SELECT count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable WHERE nameofissuer = 'ISHARES TR' AND titleofclass LIKE 'BARCLYS 20+%' AND putcall = 'Put'
